person.name: Md Nazmul Islam
person.title: PhD Candidate
person.bio: PhD Candidate @ Kent State | Robotics • Quantum Sensors • AI | Ex-Medtronic, Philips & Siemens | Exploring Claude, Codex, Cursor, Gemini & OpenClaw

paragraphs: I am a PhD researcher working at the intersection of robotics, sensing, and machine learning for healthcare. Before graduate school I spent several years in industry as a field technical specialist and service engineer with Medtronic, Philips, and Siemens, supporting clinical imaging systems and the Hugo™ robotic-assisted surgery platform in hospital environments.
That background shapes my research: I focus on systems that are interpretable, reliable, and deployable in real clinical settings.
